about: Quotations of a few sentences, with their address and the day they were read, from the terms of use page of Natural Earth and from the README of its marine areas 1:50m download (version 5.1.0), kept so that NOTICE.md can be compared with them on every machine: it must hold each of them word for word, next to its address and the day. Nothing else of those pages is copied here; their text belongs to their publishers. Spacing is normalised: runs of white space are one space.

quotations.quotation: All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain. You may use the maps in any manner, including modifying the content and design, electronic dissemination, and offset printing.
